description: Item (c) — Full iterative LP-dual u^{(ℓ)*}(β) extraction per term7-alpha5's prop:mass-formula-iterative-lp-dual. Computes u^{(ℓ)*} = m_e · tr_M(P_ℓ·β)/[n]_q! for the proton at H_3, ℓ ∈ {0, 1, 2, 3}, where P_ℓ = e_ℓ(J_1,…,J_n) acts on V_λ as c_ℓ(λ) = e_ℓ({q^{2c(□)}}). Reveals that Σ_ℓ u^{(ℓ)*}(p) at H_3 does NOT recover m_p — the sum-of-shadow-prices captures only H_3-internal structure (descended trace + JM iterates), not the gluon dressing or higher-order corrections that bring m_p to its CODATA value. Confirms that the proper iterative LP-dual is at the FULL Hecke level (which for compounds is H_6, H_9, H_12). Neutron level extraction documented as requiring the σ⁻¹-aware closed-form chain (a separate scope).
